cognates.Agents: Catalan plural of the Latinate 'agent' is 'agents' — identical by coincidence of shared morphology, not untranslated.
cognates.Articles: Catalan plural of 'article' is 'articles' — identical by shared Latinate morphology.
cognates.Avatar: 'Avatar' in Catalan; Nextcloud core ca.json also renders it 'Avatar'.
cognates.Color: 'Color' is the Catalan word (cf. Spanish 'color'), spelled identically to English.
cognates.Complex: 'Complex' is the Catalan adjective, spelled identically. Used here as a search-complexity label (SearchTrailSideBar.vue:315).
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name; kept untranslated in all 17 finished locales.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym; kept untranslated in all 17 finished locales.
cognates.Error: 'Error' is the Catalan word, spelled identically; core ca.json agrees.
cognates.Extensions: Catalan plural of 'extensió' is 'extensions' — identical by shared Latinate morphology.
cognates.Facetable: Catalan forms this adjective the same way English does, from 'facetar' + '-able', giving the identical spelling — cf. 'Immutable'. Consistent with 'facetatge' used for Faceting elsewhere in this batch.
cognates.Format: 'Format' is the Catalan noun, spelled identically.
cognates.Id: Kept as 'Id' in all 17 finished locales; following that rather than diverging on casing alone.

cognates.Interval: 'Interval' is the Catalan noun, spelled identically.
cognates.Local: 'Local' is the Catalan adjective, spelled identically. Badge marking a locally-defined schema.
cognates.Mode:: 'Mode' is the Catalan noun, spelled identically, plus a colon.
cognates.Notes: Catalan plural of 'nota' is 'notes' — identical to English by coincidence of shared Latinate morphology.
cognates.Quota: 'Quota' is the Catalan noun, spelled identically.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym, used untranslated in Catalan technical writing.
cognates.Reversible: 'Reversible' is the Catalan adjective, spelled identically.

cognates.No: 'No' is the Catalan negative, spelled identically to English; core ca.json also renders it 'No'.
cognates.Port: 'Port' is the Catalan noun for a network port, spelled identically; Nextcloud core ca.json renders it 'Port' too.
cognates.Secret: 'Secret' is the Catalan noun and adjective, spelled identically.
cognates.Simple: 'Simple' is the Catalan adjective, spelled identically. Used here as a query-complexity label alongside 'Medium' and 'Complex'.
cognates.Slug: Kept in Catalan CMS/technical UI; kept untranslated in 8 of 10 sampled locales.
cognates.Total: 'Total' is the Catalan noun, spelled identically.

cognates.Totals: Catalan plural of 'total' is 'totals' — identical to English by shared Latinate morphology.
cognates.URL: Invariant in Catalan; 'URL' is the standard form.
cognates.UUID:: Identifier acronym plus a colon. Catalan puts no space before a colon, unlike fr which carries 'UUID :'.
cognates.Webhook: Kept as 'Webhook' in Catalan; the app's existing ca glossary already renders the plural as 'Webhooks'.
